title: OK_V3 automatic assessment result
description: The JSON document a grading library prints when it has assessed a submission. Prose, examples and history are in doc/aae/feedback-format.md next to this file; this is the part a machine can check. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere and consumers ignore them, so adding an optional field is not a breaking change.

result_type.description: The format's version. The executor looks for exactly this value; anything else is not an OK_V3 document.

producer.description: Which grading library produced this, with its version: 'tiivad 0.0.33', 'silmused 1.7.11'. Free-form, for humans reading a stored result.

finished_at.description: When testing finished, UTC, ISO 8601 with a Z: 2023-08-26T21:56:00Z. Optional.

points.description: The grade, 0 to 100. This is the only number the executor reads out of the document.

pre_evaluate_error.description: Non-null when the submission could not be tested at all through the student's own fault: a syntax error, a missing required file. Shown to the student as is. When set, tests is empty.

flag_for_review.description: Optional. true asks for a teacher's eyes: core raises the course's shared review flag on this student's work on the exercise, as if a teacher had pressed the flag button. false or absent changes nothing; the flag is never cleared by a grader.

tests.description: Every test of the exercise, in the order they should be shown. A test that was not run has status SKIP rather than being left out.

title.description: The test's name as the student sees it. May be empty; must be present (EZ-1528).

user_inputs.description: The lines fed to the program on standard input, in order. Empty when there were none.

created_files.description: Text files the test placed in the working directory before running the program. Shown when non-empty.

actual_output.description: Everything the program wrote to standard output, as one string. Null when the program was not run or produced nothing worth showing.

converted_submission.description: When the test ran a modified copy of the submission, that copy. Null otherwise.

exception_message.description: A traceback or error message when the test itself could not complete. Shown to the student in full. Null when nothing went wrong.

checks.description: The checks that make up this test, in order. May be empty.

title.description: What was checked, as the student sees it. May be empty when the feedback says it all.

feedback.description: Why the check passed or failed. Should be non-empty for a failed check. A check with neither a title nor feedback is not shown.
